answer: To claim a panel seat an applicant parks 1,100 POA as a copper bond on the public seating ledge for two full epochs and publishes a pearl receipt: the hash of its custody-root fingerprint plus a hardware-attestation nonce reserved for ninety days. If a later receipt shares a 24-bit fingerprint prefix, any established reporter may take the later copper bond in full and freeze both roots from that ledge for four epochs, so cloned identities lose money at once.
